verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a fraud-protection service, so the axis applies. However, every evidence item describes Signifyd as a hosted API (servers at https://api.signifyd.com/v3) that merchants call. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-premises or open-source deployment of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
